tool_schemas.name: query
tool_schemas.description: Executes the provided SQL statement against a Microsoft SQL Server using either a full connectionString or host/port/database/username/password parameters, and returns the query result payload along with execution metadata (including status and timing) while writing an immutable audit record for the run. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required connection fields are missing, mutually exclusive connection inputs are malformed, or query is empty/invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to use the connector or the referenced credentials/profile; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when execution/audit limits are reached. Raises NOT_FOUND when a referenced connection profile/credential does not exist, and raises CONNECTION_ERROR or QUERY_ERROR when the server cannot be reached, authentication fails, or SQL execution fails (including permission errors and syntax/runtime errors).

connectionString.description: Full connection string (alternative to individual parameters)

tool_schemas.name: listConnectionProfiles
tool_schemas.description: Lists connection profiles visible to the authenticated workspace, with optional filtering by status and name, and paginated results. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR if the API key is missing/invalid or revoked.

nameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on profile name.

limit.description: Maximum number of profiles to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getConnectionProfile
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single connection profile by id. Returned objects never include raw passwords; only password_secret_ref is exposed. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist in the caller workspace.

tool_schemas.name: upsertConnectionProfile
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new connection profile or updates an existing one. On writes, any provided password is stored only in an external secret store and persisted as password_secret_ref; raw password is never returned or logged. Updates that would set an invalid lifecycle transition are rejected.

id.description: If provided, updates the existing profile; if omitted, creates a new profile.

password.description: Database password. Stored only in a secret store; never persisted directly.

status.description: Lifecycle state change for the profile. Allowed transitions: active↔disabled, active/disabled→deleted; deleted is terminal.

tool_schemas.name: listQueryExecutions
tool_schemas.description: Lists immutable query execution audit records for the authenticated workspace, with filtering and pagination. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR if the API key is missing/invalid or revoked.

fromCreatedAt.description: Filter to executions created at or after this time (RFC3339 timestamp).

toCreatedAt.description: Filter to executions created before this time (RFC3339 timestamp).

limit.description: Maximum number of executions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: cancelQueryExecution
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of an in-flight query execution. Only executions in status queued or running may be cancelled; terminal states are immutable. Returns the updated execution record on success, or refuses with CONFLICT if the execution is already terminal.
